source.title: Sydney Elliott and W. D. Flackes, Northern Ireland: A Political Directory 1968-1999 (Belfast: Blackstaff Press, 1999), Chronology of Major Events, p. 74; Dictionary, pp. 357 and 492
source.check: the date and Molyneaux's re-election from the chronology (p. 74, 15 per cent for Reynolds); Reynolds's 88 votes from pp. 357 and 492. The book gives no figure for Molyneaux, so none is recorded

note: Leadership challenge in the Ulster Unionist Council, 18 March 1995: Lee Reynolds stood against the sitting leader, James Molyneaux, who was re-elected. A party-internal contest: the electorate is the Ulster Unionist Council, not the public.
